heading.en: Messengers find the chief judge dead at the judgment seat—They are imprisoned and later released—By inspiration Nephi identifies Seantum as the murderer—Nephi is accepted by some as a prophet. About 23–21 B.C.
heading.sm: Ua maua e avefeau le faamasino sili ua maliu i le nofoa-faamasino—Ua faafalepuipuiina i latou ma toe tatala i se taimi mulimuli ane—Ua ta'u mai e Nifae, e ala i musumusuga, o Seanetuma o le fasioti tagata lena—Ua talia Nifae e ni isi, o se perofeta. E tusa o le 23–21 T.L.M.

verses.en: Behold, now it came to pass that when Nephi had spoken these words, certain men who were among them ran to the judgment– seat; yea, even there were five who went, and they said among themselves, as they went:
verses.sm: Faauta, o lenei sa oo ina ua uma ona tautala atu e Nifae o nei upu, sa i ai ni tagata o e sa i totonu ia te i latou sa taufetuli atu i le nofoa-faamasino; ioe, e toalima i latou o e na o atu, ma sa latou fai ifo i totonu ia te i latou lava, a’o latou o atu:

verses.en: Behold, now we will know of a surety whether this man be a prophet and God hath commanded him to prophesy such marvelous things unto us. Behold, we do not believe that he hath; yea, we do not believe that he is a prophet; nevertheless, if this thing which he has said concerning the chief judge be true, that he be dead, then will we believe that the other words which he has spoken are true.
verses.sm: Faauta, o le a tatou iloa moni nei pe o lenei tagata o se perofeta ma pe na poloaiina o ia e le Atua e vavalo mai ni mea ofoofogia faapea ia te i tatou. Faauta, tatou te le talitonu na ia poloaiina o ia; ioe, tatou te le talitonu o ia o se perofeta; ae ui i lea, afai e moni lenei mea na ia fai mai ai e uiga i le faamasino sili, e faapea ua oti o ia, ona tatou talitonu ai lea ua moni isi upu na ia fai mai ai.

w.en: now we will know of a surety

verses.en: And it came to pass that they ran in their might, and came in unto the judgment– seat; and behold, the chief judge had fallen to the earth, and did lie in his blood.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ai ina latou taufetuli atu ma lo latou malosi, ma ua oo atu ai i le nofoa-faamasino; ma faauta, ua pa’ū ifo le faamasino i le eleele, ma sa taoto i lona toto.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And now behold, when they saw this they were astonished exceedingly, insomuch that they fell to the earth; for they had not believed the words which Nephi had spoken concerning the chief judge.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei faauta, ina ua latou vaai i lenei mea, sa latou ofo tele, sa oo ina latou pa’u’ū ifo i le eleele; ona sa latou le talitonu i upu na tautala i ai Nifae e uiga i le faamasino sili.

verses.en: But now, when they saw they believed, and fear came upon them lest all the judgments which Nephi had spoken should come upon the people; therefore they did quake, and had fallen to the earth.
verses.sm: Ae o lenei, ina ua latou vaai, ua latou talitonu, ma sa oo mai le matatau i luga o i latou nei oo mai i luga o le nuu faamasinoga uma na tautala i ai Nifae; o lea na latou gatete ai, ma pa’u’ū ifo i le eleele.

verses.en: Now, immediately when the judge had been murdered—he being stabbed by his brother by a garb of secrecy, and he fled, and the servants ran and told the people, raising the cry of murder among them;
verses.sm: O lenei, i le taimi lava ina ua uma ona fasiotia o le faamasino— ona sa tui o ia e lona uso sa ofu faalilolilo, ma sa sola o ia, ma sa taufetuli atu auauna ma ta’u atu i tagata, ma alalaga atu ua i ai se fasioti tagata i totonu ia te i latou;

verses.en: And behold the people did gather themselves together unto the place of the judgment– seat—and behold, to their astonishment they saw those five men who had fallen to the earth.
verses.sm: Ma faauta sa faapotopoto ane faatasi e tagata i latou lava i le mea na i ai le nofoa-faamasino— ma faauta, i lo latou ofo tele, sa latou vaai atu i tagata na e toalima o e ua pa’u’ū ifo i le eleele.

verses.en: And now behold, the people knew nothing concerning the multitude who had gathered together at the garden of Nephi; therefore they said among themselves: These men are they who have murdered the judge, and God has smitten them that they could not flee from us.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei faauta, sa le iloa e tagata se mea e uiga i le motu o tagata o e sa faapotopoto faatasi i le faatoaga a Nifae; o lea na latou fai ane ai i totonu ia te i latou lava: O tagata nei o i latou ia o e na fasiotia le faamasino, ma ua taia i latou e le Atua ina ia le mafai ona latou sosola ese mai ia te i tatou.

verses.en: And it came to pass that they laid hold on them, and bound them and cast them into prison. And there was a proclamation sent abroad that the judge was slain, and that the murderers had been taken and were cast into prison.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina latou tapue i latou, ma saisai i latou ma lafo i latou i le falepuipui. Ma sa i ai se folafolaga sa auina atu faalauaitele e faapea ua fasiotia le faamasino, ma ua aveina ē na fasiotia o ia ma lafo i le falepuipui.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And it came to pass that on the morrow the people did assemble themselves together to mourn and to fast, at the burial of the great chief judge who had been slain.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo i le aso na sosoo ai sa faapotopoto faatasi e le nuu i latou lava e faanoanoa ma anapopogi, i le falelauasiga o le faamasino sili maualuga o le ua fasiotia.

verses.en: And thus also those judges who were at the garden of Nephi, and heard his words, were also gathered together at the burial.
verses.sm: Ma sa faapea foi ona faapotopoto ane faatasi faamasino o e sa i ai i le faatoaga a Nifae, ma faalogo i ana upu, i le falelauasiga.

verses.en: And it came to pass that they inquired among the people, saying: Where are the five who were sent to inquire concerning the chief judge whether he was dead? And they answered and said: Concerning this five whom ye say ye have sent, we know not; but there are five who are the murderers, whom we have cast into prison.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina latou fesilisili i tagata, e faapea: O fea o i ai le toalima o e na auina atu e fesili e uiga i le faamasino sili pe ua oti o ia? Ma sa latou tali mai ma faapea mai: E uiga i lenei toalima o e na outou fai mai na outou auina mai, matou te le iloa; ae e i ai se toalima o e na fasiotia o ia, ua matou lafoina i le falepuipui.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And it came to pass that the judges desired that they should be brought; and they were brought, and behold they were the five who were sent; and behold the judges inquired of them to know, concerning the matter, and they told them all that they had done, saying:
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina mananao faamasino ia aumai i latou; ma sa aumai i latou, ma faauta o i latou ia o le toalima o e na auina atu; ma faauta sa fesiligia i latou e faamasino ina ia latou iloa e uiga i le mataupu, ma sa latou faamatala mai ia te i latou mea uma na latou faia, e faapea:

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: We ran and came to the place of the judgment– seat, and when we saw all things even as Nephi had testified, we were astonished insomuch that we fell to the earth; and when we were recovered from our astonishment, behold they cast us into prison.
verses.sm: Sa matou taufetuli ma o atu i le mea o i ai le nofoa-faamasino, ma ina ua matou vaai atu i mea uma e pei ona sa molimau mai ai Nifae, sa matou ofo tele sa oo ai ina matou pa’u’ū ifo i le eleele; ma ina ua matou malamalama mai lo matou ofo, faauta, ua latou lafo i matou i le falepuipui.

verses.en: Now, as for the murder of this man, we know not who has done it; and only this much we know, we ran and came according as ye desired, and behold he was dead, according to the words of Nephi.
verses.sm: O lenei, e uiga i le fasiotiga o lenei tagata, matou te le iloa po o ai na faia; ma ua na’o le pau lenei o le mea ua matou iloa, sa matou taufetuli ma o mai e tusa ma lo outou manao, ma faauta, ua oti o ia, e tusa ma upu a Nifae.

verses.en: And now it came to pass that the judges did expound the matter unto the people, and did cry out against Nephi, saying: Behold, we know  that this Nephi must have agreed with someone to slay the judge, and then he might declare it unto us, that he might convert us unto his faith, that he might raise himself to be a great man, chosen of God, and a prophet.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei sa oo ina faamalamalama atu le mataupu e faamasino i tagata, ma alalaga e faasaga ia Nifae, ua faapea mai: Faauta, ua matou iloa atonu sa faia e lenei Nifae se ioega faatasi ma se tasi e fasioti le faamasino, ma a uma ona ia ta’u mai lea ia te i tatou, ina ia mafai e ia ona faaliliu atu i tatou i lona faatuatuaga, ina ia mafai ona ia faatu a’e o ia lava o se tagata maoae, ua filifilia e le Atua, ma o se perofeta.

verses.en: And now behold, we will detect this man, and he shall confess his fault and make known unto us the true murderer of this judge.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, faauta, o le a matou faaalia lenei tagata, ma o le a ia ta’u mai lona sese ma faailoa mai ia te i tatou le tagata moni na fasiotia lenei faamasino.

verses.en: And it came to pass that the five were liberated on the day of the burial. Nevertheless, they did rebuke the judges in the words which they had spoken against Nephi, and did contend with them one by one, insomuch that they did confound them.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina faasaoloto le toalima i le aso o le falelauasiga. Ae ui i lea, sa latou tauseseina faamasino i upu na latou tautatala i ai e faasaga ia Nifae, ma latou finau ma i latou taitoatasi, sa oo ai lava ina fefinauai i latou.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: Nevertheless, they caused that Nephi should be taken and bound and brought before the multitude, and they began to question him in divers ways that they might cross him, that they might accuse him to death—
verses.sm: Ae ui i lea, sa latou faatonu atu ia pu’e Nifae ma saisai ma aumai i luma o le motu o tagata, ma sa amata ona latou fesiligia o ia i ala eseese ina ia mafai ona latou faasese o ia, ina ia mafai ona latou tausalaina o ia i le oti—

verses.en: Saying unto him: Thou art confederate; who is this man that hath done this murder? Now tell us, and acknowledge thy fault; saying, Behold here is money; and also we will grant unto thee thy life if thou wilt tell us, and acknowledge the agreement which thou hast made with him.
verses.sm: Ua fai mai ia te ia: O oe o se taupulepule; o ai lenei tagata na fasiotia o ia? O lenei ia ta’u mai ia te i matou, ma tautino mai lou sese; faapea mai: Faauta o tupe nei; ma o le a matou tuu atu foi ia te oe lou ola pe afai e te ta’u mai ia te i matou, ma tautino mai le maliega lea na e faia faatasi ma ia.

verses.en: But Nephi said unto them: O ye fools, ye uncircumcised of heart, ye blind, and ye stiffnecked people, do ye know how long the Lord your God will suffer you that ye shall go on in this your way of sin?
verses.sm: Peitai sa fai atu Nifae ia te i latou: E, outou vale e, outou e ua le peritomeina i le loto, outou o tauaso, ma outou tagata ua maaa, tou te iloa ea o le a le umi o le a faamafatiaina ai outou e le Alii lo outou Atua ia outou ui ai pea i lenei ala o lo outou agasala?

verses.en: O ye ought to begin to howl and mourn, because of the great destruction which at this time doth await you, except ye shall repent.
verses.sm: E, ua tatau lava ia te outou ona amata ona outou uio ma faavauvau, ona o le faafanoga tele lea ua faatalitali mai i le taimi nei ia te outou, vagana ai ua outou salamo.

verses.en: Behold ye say that I have agreed with a man that he should murder Seezoram, our chief judge. But behold, I say unto you, that this is because I have testified unto you that ye might know concerning this thing; yea, even for a witness unto you, that I did know of the wickedness and abominations which are among you.
verses.sm: Faauta ua outou fai mai na ou ioe faatasi ma se tagata ia fasioti e ia Sesorama, lo tatou faamasino sili. Ae faauta, ou te fai atu ia te outou, ua outou fai mai faapea ona sa ou molimau atu ia te outou ina ia mafai ona outou iloa e uiga i lenei mea; ioe, sa ou ta’u atu lava lenei mea o se molimau ia te outou, ua ou iloa e uiga i le amioleaga ma mea inosia ia ua i ai i totonu ia te outou.

verses.en: And because I have done this, ye say that I have agreed with a man that he should do this thing; yea, because I showed unto you this sign ye are angry with me, and seek to destroy my life.
verses.sm: Ma ona ua ou faailoa atu lenei mea, ua outou fai mai sa ou ioe faatasi ma se tagata ia ona faia lenei mea; ioe, ona sa ou faaali atu ia te outou lenei faailoga ua outou feitai mai ai ia te au, ma saili e faaumatia lo’u ola.

verses.en: And now behold, I will show unto you another sign, and see if ye will in this thing seek to destroy me.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei faauta, o le a ou faaali atu ia te outou se isi faailoga, ma vaai pe o le a outou saili ai e faaumatia au i lenei mea.

verses.en: Behold I say unto you: Go to the house of Seantum, who is the brother of Seezoram, and say unto him—
verses.sm: Faauta ou te fai atu ia te outou: O i le fale o Seanetuma, o le uso lea o Sesorama, ma fai atu ia te ia—

verses.en: Has Nephi, the pretended prophet, who doth prophesy so much evil concerning this people, agreed with thee, in the which ye have murdered Seezoram, who is your brother?
verses.sm: Pe na ioe ea Nifae, le faatagā perofeta, o le ua ia vavalo mai se leaga e tele i lenei nuu, faatasi ma oe, i se ioega na e fasiotia ai Sesorama, o lou uso?

verses.en: And behold, he shall say unto you, Nay.
verses.sm: Ma faauta, o le a fai mai o ia ia te outou, E leai.

verses.en: And ye shall say unto him: Have ye murdered your brother?
verses.sm: Ma ia outou fai atu ia te ia: Na e fasiotia lou uso?

verses.en: And he shall stand with fear, and wist not what to say. And behold, he shall deny unto you; and he shall make as if he were astonished; nevertheless, he shall declare unto you that he is innocent.
verses.sm: Ma o le a tu o ia ma le fefe, ma le iloa se upu e fai mai. Ma faauta, o le a faafiti mai o ia ia te outou; ma o le a faia e ia e peiseai ua te’i; ae ui i lea, o le a ia fai mai ia te outou ua mama o ia.

verses.en: But behold, ye shall examine him, and ye shall find blood upon the skirts of his cloak.
verses.sm: Ae faauta, ia outou suesue o ia, ma o le a outou maua le toto i le vaega i lalo o lona ofu pulupulu.

verses.en: And when ye have seen this, ye shall say: From whence cometh this blood? Do we not know that it is the blood of your brother?
verses.sm: Ma a uma ona outou vaai i lenei mea, ia outou fai atu: E mai fea lenei toto? Matou te le iloa ea o le toto lenei o lou uso?

verses.en: And then shall he tremble, and shall look pale, even as if death had come upon him.
verses.sm: Ma a uma o le a gatete ai o ia, ma foliga mai ua sesega, e pei lava ua oo mai le oti i ona luga.

verses.en: And then shall ye say: Because of this fear and this paleness which has come upon your face, behold, we know that thou art guilty.
verses.sm: Ma a uma ona outou fai atu lea ia te ia: Ona o lenei fefe ma lenei sesega lea ua oo mai i ou mata, faauta, ua matou iloa ua e sala.

verses.en: And then shall greater fear come upon him; and then shall he confess unto you, and deny no more that he has done this murder.
verses.sm: Ma a uma o le a oo mai se mata’u tele atu i ona luga; ma ona ia tautino mai ai lea ia te outou, ma ia le toe faafitia o ia lava na faia lenei fasioti tagata.

verses.en: And then shall he say unto you, that I, Nephi, know nothing concerning the matter save it were given unto me by the power of God. And then shall ye know that I am an honest man, and that I am sent unto you from God.
verses.sm: Ma a uma o le a fai mai o ia ia te outou, o a’u, o Nifae, ua ou le iloa se mea e uiga i le mataupu vagana ai ua tuuina mai ia te a’u e le mana o le Atua. Ma o le a outou iloa ai o a’u o se tagata faamaoni, ma ua auina mai a’u ia te outou mai le Atua.

w.en: that I am an honest man,

verses.en: And it came to pass that they went and did, even according as Nephi had said unto them. And behold, the words which he had said were true; for according to the words he did deny; and also according to the words he did confess.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina latou o atu ma faia, e tusa lava e pei ona fai atu ai Nifae ia te i latou. Ma faauta, sa moni upu na ia fai mai ai; ona e tusa ma upu sa faafitia e ia; ma e tusa foi ma upu sa tautino mai e ia.

w.en: And it came to pass that
and also according to the words

verses.en: And he was brought to prove that he himself was the very murderer, insomuch that the five were set at liberty, and also was Nephi.
verses.sm: Ma sa aumai o ia e faamaonia o ia lava o le fasioti tagata lea, sa oo ina tatala faasaoloto le toalima, faapea foi ma Nifae.

verses.en: And there were some of the Nephites who believed on the words of Nephi; and there were some also, who believed because of the testimony of the five, for they had been converted while they were in prison.
verses.sm: Ma sa i ai ni isi o sa Nifaē o e na talitonu i upu a Nifae; ma sa i ai foi ni isi, o e na talitonu ona o le molimau a le toalima, ona sa faaliliuina i latou a’o latou i ai i le falepuipui.

verses.en: And now there were some among the people, who said that Nephi was a prophet.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei sa i ai ni isi i totonu o le nuu, o e na fai mai o Nifae o se perofeta.

verses.en: And there were others who said: Behold, he is a god, for except he was a god he could not know of all things. For behold, he has told us the thoughts of our hearts, and also has told us things; and even he has brought unto our knowledge the true murderer of our chief judge.
verses.sm: Ma sa i ai ni isi o e na fai mai: Faauta, o ia o se atua, ona vagana ai o ia o se atua po ua le mafai ona ia iloaina mea uma. Auā faauta, na ia ta’u mai ia te i tatou mafaufauga o o tatou loto, ma sa ia ta’u mai foi mea ia te i tatou; ma sa ia faailoa mai lava ia i tatou le tagata moni na fasiotia lo tatou faamasino sili.
